intents_zh: 彩色 prefix log 聚合
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

colors=(31 32 33 34 35 36)
i=0
for f in {{log_glob}}; do
  c=${colors[$((i % ${#colors[@]}))]}
  name=$(basename "$f")
  ( tail -n 0 -F "$f" | sed -u "s/^/\x1b[${c}m[$name]\x1b[0m /" ) &
  i=$((i+1))
done
wait
summary_zh: 並行 tail 多個 log 加彩色 prefix
